title: cryptocarya lanceolata
intro: Cryptocarya lanceolata, commonly known as East Indian Sandalwood or Yellow Sandalwood, is a plant species native to Australia and Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and promote relaxation, which is attributed to its therapeutic actions as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of the plant include essential oils, primarily consisting of linalool and β-santalol, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The plant is also valued for its wood, which is highly prized for its fragrance and used in traditional medicine to treat a range of ailments, including fever and skin conditions.
